items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: if I’m at a gig say, and I remember being on the gig once with Jeff Hamilton out in California... Now when I was playing with Jeff

ctx.x: And you have a lot of power it seems to me.

It is, and sometimes you play with — if I’m at a gig say, and I remember being on the gig once with Jeff Hamilton out in California, a wonderful drummer. Now when I was playing with Jeff, and we hadn’t played together before, I’m going to let Jeff lead, even though he may not be leading the set, you know what I mean, but we’re in a trio or a quartet and someone’s out front playing, I forget who it was at the time. But my eyes were on Jeff. Whatever Jeff does I’m going to — so I noticed when he was in two, and I…
